question: Where are a café positioned toward the southwest of Dawson Cole Fine Art, Laguna Beach, CA and inside 130 kilometers?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois AS p WHERE p.amenity = 'cafe' AND ST_DWithin( p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Dawson Cole Fine Art%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Laguna Beach%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CA%' LIMIT 1)::geography, 130000 -- 130 kilometers in meters ) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Dawson Cole Fine Art%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Laguna Beach%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CA%' LIMIT 1), p.geometry )) BETWEEN 202.5 AND 247.5;
